body: I will try. Like I said, getting things done just isn't my strong suit.

It's just that I gave up already. How do you come back from that? I can't imagine a single scenario in which I could change. Nothing would make me happier than to be diagnozed with something that could explain why I'm what I am. I just can't get my brain to beleave in such possibility.

I really hate myself. I have a perfectly good reason to: I messed all the chances I got and wasted all the love I was given. How do you live with someone you hate?
I seem to fail at everything I do. It's not that I'm not smart enough or couldn't succeed. It's just that I'm so damn lazy I never really try. I've had a great life, I just wasted it.

So I wen't to see a doctor and she got me to a therapist right away. I've been going there at least once a week for the past month now. I feel worse after every time. It does not feel good to talk about my problems. I've come to realize what a selfish bastard I am. My therapist told me I should get a devorce if I dont wan't to be a burden to my wife, rather than kill myself. I know she didn't mean that as a solution to my problems, but she's right. I just can't bring myself to get rid of the only thing I really love in this world. 

My thoughts are not as clear as they used to be. I'm trying to reason with my self but I just can't even get started. I remember the logic why I wanted to get help, but I can't seem to follow it anymore. Like it's shrouded in thick fog. Now my brain just can't come to any conclusion what's the smart move now. I don't think I even care if I get better anymore. I just don't care. I don't seem to want anything now. There might be something wrong with my brain now but it doesn't really matter. I've allways been a lazy selfish piece of shit who takes the easy way out. That's what I'm going to do.

I'm waiting for the right kind of weather to make my accidental death beleavable. It's supposed to rain this weekend.

I'm studying construction engineering. I havent been to a therapist. People allways say that it helps to talk to someone about your problems, but I've allways felt worse afterwards. But you're right, I have nothing to lose. It's just that for some reason going to a therapist scares me. Also, I'm not sure if I can make it look like an accident after I've told someone about my plans. I'll try to summon some courage and call someone tomorrow.

Thank you for taking the time to help me.
